sentences.text: Ankit Patel vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 28 February, 2023

Author: Surya Prakash Kesarwani
Bench: Surya Prakash Kesarwani
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 3
Case :- Writ - C No. - 36873 of 2022
Petitioner :- Ankit Patel
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 4 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Parvez Iqbal Ansari

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Surya Prakash Kesarwani,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the impugned order dated 03.06.2022, although appealable under Section 70 of the Food Safety Standards Act, 2006; yet the writ petition is maintainable inasmuch as the impugned order has been passed without confronting the petitioner with the enquiry report and without affording any opportunity of hearing.
He, therefore, submits that the impugned order is in breach of principals of natural justice and deserves to be interfered with by this Court.

Shri Amit Manohar, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel submits that the petitioner may approach the respondent no.3, who shall pass an order afresh in accordance with law after confronting the petitioner with the relied upon materials/report of the Food Safety Officer, Ballia dated 27.01.2022.

entities.text: Ankit Patel vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the aforesaid and without expressing any opinion on merits of the case of the petitioner,
this writ petition is disposed of by quashing the impugned order dated 03.06.2022 and remitting the matter back to the respondent no.3 with a direction to pass an order afresh in accordance with law after confronting all adverse materials to the petitioner including the report of the Food Safety Officer, Ballia dated 27.01.2022.
It is made clear that we have not expressed any opinion on merits of the case of the petitioner.

Order Date :- 28.2.2023 Ankit.
